instruments.name: PPF
instruments.notes: Interest rate revised quarterly by Ministry of Finance. Historical average ~7.5-8%. EEE status: contribution, interest, and maturity all exempt. Partial withdrawal after 7 years. Source: finmin.nic.in

instruments.name: ELSS
instruments.notes: Shortest lock-in among 80C instruments. Returns vary widely by fund. 12% is a conservative long-run SIP estimate based on Nifty 50 historical CAGR. LTCG above Rs 1.25 lakh taxed at 12.5% from FY 2024-25. Source: amfiindia.com

instruments.name: NPS
instruments.notes: Lock-in until age 60. 60% corpus tax-free at maturity; 40% mandatorily annuitised. Returns depend on allocation between equity (E), corporate bonds (C), and government securities (G). 10% reflects moderate E50 allocation. Source: pfrda.org.in

instruments.name: NSC
instruments.notes: Interest rate 7.7% for Q1 FY 2025-26. Interest accrues and is reinvested each year; that reinvested interest also qualifies as 80C deduction. Maturity proceeds taxable as income from other sources. Source: indiapost.gov.in

instruments.name: SSY
instruments.notes: Only for girl child below 10. Account matures when girl turns 21 or on marriage after 18. EEE status. Rate 8.2% for Q1 FY 2025-26. Max Rs 1.5 lakh per year. Source: indiapost.gov.in

instruments.name: ULIP
instruments.notes: Returns after deducting fund management charges. Maturity proceeds exempt if annual premium does not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh (from FY 2021-22 for new policies). High charges make long-term returns lower than pure equity. Included for completeness.

instruments.name: Tax_FD
instruments.notes: 5-year lock-in FD with scheduled banks. Interest is fully taxable as per slab rate, which significantly erodes effective return at higher tax brackets. Useful for those who prefer certainty over returns.

instruments.name: LIC
instruments.notes: Premium on life insurance policies for self, spouse, children. Policy must be for minimum 2x annual premium sum assured. Returns on endowment policies are low (4-6%) but maturity is tax-free if premium is under 10% of sum assured.

instruments.name: Health_Insurance
instruments.notes: Not an investment instrument; included for deduction mapping. Deduction: Rs 25,000 for self and family, Rs 25,000 additional for parents, Rs 50,000 if parents are senior citizens. Preventive health check-up Rs 5,000 within these limits.

return_assumptions.note: All return assumptions are long-run averages for projection purposes. Actual returns vary. Sources: mospi.gov.in for CPI, RBI for risk-free rate, amfiindia.com for equity market data.
